title: Best Habits App
body: Tried them all and this is by far the best and easiest to use.
author: HishamOmz

title: The best app to build habits out there
author: chertik77

title: For my needs this is by far the best tracker app.
body: It’s amazing, shows habits like GitHub contributions, I love it, it it’s simple and even has shortcuts support so I can set it one of my nfc tags to log a habit when I scan it with my phone automatically, best of all, the free version allows for three habits to track so you can use it for free without huge limitations.
author: OctoCuber

title: Great UI/UX
body: Very well designed app. Incredibly useful.
author: M. Apple

title: Perfect!
body: Does everything you expect it to do and it does them well! Can’t recommend highly enough ✨
author: lewis.kj

title: Beautifully designed
body: When I discovered this app it was at the right time as I needed something to track my driving theory mock tests…I now use it for everything
author: ryadraws

title: Love it!
body: Super nice and easy to use! Have just one question: could we maybe get a space to leave notes under each check in? I’m using it to track my music production and I’d like to write down how the session went. Just an idea! Will defo keep on using it regardless!
author: What in Darnation

title: The perfect habit tracker
body: I have been using this app since launch, experienced no bugs and enjoyed how minimal and simple it is to use. The widgets work great, and the developer seems to be very active when it comes to adding new features regularly. Thanks!
author: F35LightningII

title: Stellar! Works for me where other apps don’t
body:
I love this app. Perhaps it is because I’m a developer myself but the GitHub like tracking just works so nicely for me! Clean, simple. Excellent work! 

Perhaps reminders to check in would be helpful? I use it to track whether I have taken medication for example and an 8am nudge would be lovely.
author: AndrewBestUk

title: Simple to setup and easy to use
body:
Setup very easy to do, with the ease of a single button to check in.

Widgets work effectively without needing to go back into the app to confirm.
author: theprof1986

title: Amazing!
body:
I’ve been looking forever and a day for a habit-tracker app that allows you to have a task with a completely open schedule. None of the apps I’ve used (and I’ve used them all) allow for this.

One thing I would say is that I’d love the main menu to have the option to be a bit more compact; maybe without the calendar which would become visible when expanding the board?

I’m going to trial it for a bit but I’ve definitely got eyes on the power pack if all goes well
author: Thirteenth Step
